sources.citation: 張守祥 (Zhang Shouxiang) 2012 [issue dated 2011].「「満州国」における言語接触―新資料に見られる言語接触の実態―」『人文』(学習院大学人文科学研究所) 10: 51-68.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sec. 5.3 音韻上の特徴 (p.61): the katakana renderings on military postcards try to approximate Mandarin but 'cannot show the changes of the four tones' so words drift from the original pronunciation (洋車→ヤンチェー, 落了馬了→ラオラマーラ). Also quotes Nakao Sasuke: 'grammar and vocabulary roughly Chinese, but the pronunciation is kana-spelling pronunciation'. No statement on word stress/accent placement.

sources.citation: 桜井隆 (Sakurai Takashi) 2012.「満州ピジン中国語と協和語」[Manchuria Pidgin Chinese and Kyowa-go].『明海日本語』17: 1-15. (Glottolog's only 'overview' ref, hh:698170)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. A terminological/historical survey of the names given to the pidgin (日支合弁語, 沿線官話, 兵隊支那語, 協和語..); the only pronunciation remark is a quotation (Nomura 1995) that the pidgin mixed 'katakana pronunciation' with Japanese (p.4). No accent/stress/tone statement.
